$comment: Each fixture must produce exactly the violation it exists to produce. prove-workflows.py --fixtures fails if one does not — a guard with no violating case to catch is a guard nobody has seen work. See README.md.

cases.$why: Declares its own approved list so the fixture proves the rule rather than the host's checkout. It fired only when RealityEngine_CI was present, and passed silently in a hosted lane where it was not.
